name: March of the Dawnflame
text:
As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.
I — Create a 1/1 white and red Human Soldier creature token with haste. It attacks this turn if able.
II — Exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls. March of the Dawnflame deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
III — Creatures you control get +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn. Untap those creatures.
